prior_audit.method: Direct fetch of audit/lessons-only/sections/S31.json returned 404 before creation.

roadmap.T1: nodos, aristas, dirección y peso; multigrafo, tiempo y provenance
roadmap.T2: clientes/entidades/transacciones/contactos; deduplicación y agregación sin borrar detalle
roadmap.T3: grado, componentes y caminos; centralidad con interpretación limitada
roadmap.T4: subgrafos y pruebas; visualización, escalabilidad, privacidad y evidencia por arista
roadmap.gate: grafo temporal que responde cómo están conectados con un camino reproducible y no convierte centralidad en culpabilidad

live_surface.card_tagline: grafo de evidencia relacional: responde cómo están conectados con camino reproducible y sin convertir centralidad en culpabilidad

learner_entry_state.critical_dependency_warning: S30 is REPAIR_REQUIRED; its cluster edges are not trustworthy without exact source/entity versions, decision/evidence ids, model/policy version and cannot-link checks.
carry_forward_required: same-entity links distinct from relationship evidence

runtime_adversarial_validation.test: three parallel A-B edges through T3-A adjacency=set
runtime_adversarial_validation.expected_contract: multigraph degree counts three incident edges

runtime_adversarial_validation.test: graph edges A-B plus declared isolated node Z
runtime_adversarial_validation.observed: components() omits Z because only adjacency keys are traversed
runtime_adversarial_validation.expected_contract: isolated node is a connected component

runtime_adversarial_validation.observed: returns only ['A','B','C']; no edge ids/types/timestamps/provenance remain
shared_phone flag True despite only one entity
raw set construction collapses them to one node
sum/count double and record id repeated

external_research.finding: source+target returns a list of nodes, not multiedge keys/evidence payloads
components partition graph nodes; a graph with one isolated node is connected
MultiGraph/MultiDiGraph represent multiedges and edge attributes carry data
provenance commonly links entities, activities/agents and time; used only as an external benchmark, not a mandatory schema
example.com/example.org are documentation domains; example.pe is not reserved

findings.evidence: Roadmap requires S30; authoritative roadmap also says S31 must not start until S30/CP-N3-A is approved, while S30 audit is REPAIR_REQUIRED.
findings.impact: Graph nodes/clusters can persist false ER merges as if they were relational truth.
findings.proposal: Declare S30 artifacts untrusted until upstream regression/gate passes; graph fixtures should be independent synthetic truth meanwhile.

findings.evidence: Text says S30 resolved identities and canonical ER ids feed graph nodes, but S30 union edges lack required immutable decision/evidence/cannot-link provenance.
findings.impact: A bad identity merge becomes a supernode that fabricates downstream paths and centrality.
findings.proposal: Require node lineage back to canonical pair, source/entity versions, decision/evidence ids and model/policy version.

findings.evidence: Since S27 roadmap requires systematic pytest, but S31 mostly prints outputs and uses plain asserts; graph invariants do not produce a section-level pytest gate.
findings.impact: Broken provenance/path semantics can still look green in screenshots/output.
findings.proposal: Move graph invariants and regression cases into pytest with failing exit status.

findings.evidence: Uses @example.pe; IANA reserves example.com/example.org and special-use test names, not example.pe.
findings.impact: Synthetic examples can accidentally cross a real namespace boundary.
findings.proposal: Use @equipo.test or example.com.

findings.evidence: Section requires a multigraph and citable evidence per hop, yet no stable edge_id/key is defined for parallel edges.
findings.impact: A node pair can have several edges but a path cannot name which exact observation supports the hop.
findings.proposal: Give each raw/derived edge a stable edge_id and preserve MultiGraph-style edge keys.

findings.evidence: Prose defines provenance as source_system+run_id+record_id. T1-A stores only record_id; T1-B stores source+record_id, no run_id and field naming differs.
findings.impact: The course's own minimum provenance contract is not met by its canonical examples.
findings.proposal: One edge schema with source_system, run_id, record_id, edge_id and timestamp/version fields where applicable.

findings.evidence: shared_phone/shared_email are declared derived shortcuts, but shared_phone carries a single record_id as if one source row proved a two-entity shared-value relation.
findings.impact: Derived relationship loses the two observations and derivation that justify it.
findings.proposal: Derived edge references both source observations plus derivation/version; primary contact-node edges remain authoritative.

findings.evidence: Reference says transfer is account→account, never person→person; multigraph_prov creates transfer E1→E2 entities.
findings.impact: Learner cannot know whether a direct entity transfer edge is valid and paths erase account ownership hops.
findings.proposal: Keep transfer account→account or label any entity-level edge explicitly as a derived projection with provenance.

findings.evidence: T1-A requires units per etype; T1-B uses generic amount for transfer and shared_email, with no unit.
findings.impact: Aggregations/rankings can combine semantically different quantities.
findings.proposal: Use weight+unit consistently and avoid amount on non-monetary edges.

findings.evidence: Text promises path/aggregate filtering by time window; code only stores/sorts timestamps and never filters a window.
findings.impact: Edges from incompatible years can be combined into a misleading relationship path.
findings.proposal: Implement window predicate and preserve timezone-aware timestamps; test inclusion/exclusion boundaries.

findings.evidence: Builder emits owns/transfer/has_phone/has_email edges without record_id/source_system/run_id/ts despite reference input contract.
findings.impact: The main table→graph transformation produces unauditable edges.
findings.proposal: Every emitted edge inherits exact source row identity and run provenance.

findings.evidence: Entity ids, account ids and raw contact values are unioned into one set of strings without kind namespace.
findings.impact: An entity id equal to a phone/email/account string silently collapses distinct node types.
findings.proposal: Use typed node keys such as ('entity',id), ('account',id), ('phone',normalized_value_id).

findings.evidence: Raw emails and phones are node IDs; T4 only masks display labels.
findings.impact: PII remains embedded in graph identity, logs, serialized payloads and screenshots even if labels are redacted.
findings.proposal: Use pseudonymous contact-value ids; authorized evidence store resolves them separately.

findings.evidence: shared = len(phones) != len(set(phones)) detects duplicate rows, not two distinct entities sharing the same phone.
findings.impact: A duplicate ingestion row can fabricate a shared-contact signal.
findings.proposal: Group normalized value→distinct canonical entity ids and require cardinality >=2.

findings.evidence: Text says stable ids make construction idempotent; stable node labels alone do not prevent duplicate edge materialization on replay.
findings.impact: Retry/reingestion can duplicate multiedges or aggregates.
findings.proposal: Define edge identity/upsert/replay semantics and test build(build_input twice) equivalence.

findings.evidence: Narrative requires raw_id→canonical_id map to rewrite edges; dedup_agg code never implements the map or rewiring.
findings.impact: Lineage from raw identities to canonical nodes is promised but absent.
findings.proposal: Persist resolution-map version and use it explicitly during edge projection.

findings.evidence: Aggregation does not deduplicate record_id; replay of tx-1 doubles sum/count and stores tx-1 twice.
findings.impact: Retries inflate money/frequency and hub/path evidence.
findings.proposal: Dedup by immutable source-event identity before aggregation; flag conflicting duplicate payloads.

findings.evidence: Prose says key includes unit/window when applicable; code key is only src,dst,etype.
findings.impact: Different units/windows can be merged into one summary.
findings.proposal: Version aggregation policy and include unit/window/direction dimensions explicitly.

findings.evidence: Aggregate retains only record_id list, while source/run/time are omitted and min/max ts promised in prose are absent.
findings.impact: A reviewer cannot resolve ambiguous record ids across systems/runs or verify temporal scope.
findings.proposal: Keep structured detail refs (source_system,run_id,record_id,ts) and derive summary metadata.

findings.evidence: Paragraph correctly defines degree as number of incident edges in multigraph; code stores neighbors in set and degree=len(adj[n]), counting distinct neighbors instead.
findings.impact: Ten parallel transfers become degree 1, directly contradicting the lesson.
findings.proposal: Represent edge multiplicity or use MultiGraph degree; separately expose unique-neighbor count.

findings.evidence: components() iterates adjacency keys created from edges; isolated declared nodes never appear. NetworkX defines a single isolated node as a connected component.
findings.impact: Case isolates disappear from graph-quality/cardinality checks.
findings.proposal: Build components over explicit node set plus adjacency.

findings.evidence: Paragraph says reproducible path lists nodes and supporting edges/record_ids; bfs_path returns only node list.
findings.impact: The gate asks 'what supports each step?' but code cannot answer it.
findings.proposal: Return ordered hops containing edge_id, type, direction, ts, source/run/record refs.

findings.evidence: adjacency set collapses all parallel edge distinctions and metadata before BFS.
findings.impact: Even if later adding edge evidence, the traversal no longer knows which multiedge was used.
findings.proposal: Traverse edge records/keys, not neighbor-only set, and define deterministic edge-selection rule.

findings.evidence: BFS ignores timestamps/windows entirely.
findings.impact: A path can stitch edges that never coexisted in the case window.
findings.proposal: Filter eligible edges by explicit as-of/window before traversal and include window in returned evidence.

findings.evidence: Callout says networkx.shortest_path covers the same contract on MultiGraph; current NetworkX returns a list of nodes for source+target, not edge keys/evidence.
findings.impact: Learner may think switching libraries automatically solves evidence-path provenance.
findings.proposal: Say NetworkX covers shortest-node-path traversal; edge-key/evidence resolution remains application logic.

findings.evidence: Prose requires etype/time/node-kind context before prioritization; code has untyped timeless edges and literal not_guilt=True.
findings.impact: Ethical interpretation is narrated but not executable/auditable.
findings.proposal: Compute metric on a declared filtered graph and return filter context alongside score.

findings.evidence: Text requires self-loop, graph weight, provenance and idempotence tests; code asserts reachability plus all(w>=0 for w in [1,2,0]), an unrelated literal list.
findings.impact: The advertised quality gate does not test the graph it claims to validate.
findings.proposal: Create pytest fixtures with actual edge metadata and explicit red tests for each invariant.

findings.evidence: build(edges) accepts only (u,v) and discards type, weight, provenance and time.
findings.impact: Most stated invariants are impossible to verify after construction.
findings.proposal: Test the canonical typed edge model rather than a metadata-free shadow graph.

findings.evidence: With defaultdict, ego(adj,'MISSING') returns {'MISSING'} instead of applying a declared missing-seed policy.
findings.impact: A nonexistent entity can appear as a one-node case subgraph.
findings.proposal: Validate seed membership and raise typed error or return explicit not_found result.

findings.evidence: Prose says roles see only what they need; code implements display masking only, no role/authorization check.
findings.impact: Masking can be mistaken for access control.
findings.proposal: Bound the lab claim to redaction or add an explicit role-policy adapter/test.

findings.evidence: edge_evidence uses store.get(edge_id,{}) and silently returns empty dict for unknown edge.
findings.impact: A missing evidence object can render as a blank hop instead of blocking the explanation.
findings.proposal: Raise EvidenceNotFound/return typed error; path publication fails closed when any hop evidence is unavailable.

findings.evidence: Storyboard says each hop shows records, ts and source; the store contains records/source but no ts.
findings.impact: Learner cannot reproduce the advertised reviewer evidence panel.
findings.proposal: Store per-record timestamps or detail refs and render exact hop evidence.

findings.evidence: Storyboard path is E1→ph:900→E2, but code contains only one direct transfer edge and never constructs ego/path/hop clicks.
findings.impact: The section gate's principal user flow exists only in prose.
findings.proposal: Execute the same CASO-LIM-031 path through graph builder, ego extraction, traversal and evidence resolver.

findings.evidence: Code prints 'subgraph_only' but implements neither n_nodes render threshold nor summary mode/top hubs/components/etype counts.
findings.impact: A declared scalability policy is represented by a string rather than behavior.
findings.proposal: Implement small-vs-summary decision function with illustrative configurable threshold and tests.

findings.evidence: Figure alt says Ana is directly connected to Luis through a transfer, but canonical schema says transfer is account→account and entity relationship path must preserve owns hops.
findings.impact: The visual teaches a topology that the reference explicitly forbids and erases ownership evidence.
findings.proposal: Draw entity→owns→account→transfer→account←owns←entity, or label any direct entity transfer edge as a derived projection with source path.

rejected_findings.suspicion: Contact values should never be graph nodes.
rejected_findings.defense: Contact-as-node is a useful bipartite modeling pattern; defects are raw PII ids, missing namespace and provenance.

rejected_findings.suspicion: Traversing an undirected projection of directed evidence is always wrong.
rejected_findings.defense: For a connectedness question an explicit undirected projection is legitimate if returned hops preserve original direction/type/provenance.

rejected_findings.suspicion: Degree centrality deg/(n-1) is technically wrong.
rejected_findings.defense: The paragraph explicitly scopes the formula to simple undirected graphs without self-loops, matching NetworkX's documented definition.
Summary plus retained structured detail is sound; the current defects are replay, temporal dimensions and incomplete provenance.

rejected_findings.suspicion: Centrality should not be taught in investigation contexts.
rejected_findings.defense: Structural centrality is legitimate when presented with strong context and non-culpability boundaries.

rejected_findings.suspicion: Pure-Python BFS is pedagogically inferior to NetworkX.
rejected_findings.defense: Pure Python is useful for learning; the defect is throwing away edge evidence, not library choice.
